title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theater on 1972-10-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a late‑'72 show with a smoking Dark Star→Morning Dew and tight band interplay
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that preserves the band's dynamics with only minor mix quirks. Musically the night shines thanks to a monster Dark Star into Morning Dew, powerful Bird Song, rousing Big Railroad/El Paso sequence and a high‑energy second set packed with Playing in the Band, Deal, Promised Land and OMSN→Casey Jones. The band is tight, Keith’s keyboards sparkle, Phil’s bass dominates at times, and Jerry’s vocals are sweet throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Four enthusiastic reviews (three 5‑star, one 4‑star) highlight a high‑energy performance and a mostly pristine soundboard recording; the weighted rating reflects strong show quality with only minor technical comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix overall; occasional slight cut in Dark Star and a few instruments (Bob's guitar) noted as slightly forward, but no major dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds from early‑show energy (Bertha, Me & My Uncle) to a tight mid‑set groove; second set launches with an intense Playing in the Band and flows through an expansive Dark Star, seamless transitions into Morning Dew, then finishes strong with Deal, Promised Land, Brokedown and OMSN→Casey Jones.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sweet vocals throughout; beautiful vocal delivery on Bird Song and Morning Dew; solid guitar runs though less wah‑wah than other '72 versions.
band_member_comments.Phil: Powerful, high‑in‑mix bass with standout solo during Dark Star; often described as "bombing" the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Strong chord progressions on Me & My Uncle and Brown Eyed Women; guitar sometimes a bit forward but delivers powerful screams on Deal and Promised Land.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is firmly rooted, offers some of his best playing of the era with notable solos on Big Railroad and China>Rider; shines throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (drummer) drives the band with ferocious energy, especially in Playing in the Band and the Dark Star groove.
